validation.result: Passed unchanged, including user-existing modifications. In-memory TypeScript transpilation provided source exports instead of ../dist; no source/test/dist writes.

Full-subset oracle equals physical legalMoves; structural and default-resolution representative classes complete/deduplicated; permutation deterministic; wildcard usages non-joker; input unchanged. Hands are three targeted 8-card types per level, plus a 10-card bomb hand at level 7.
Each wildcard independently takes every value 2..15 and each ordinary suit; type/value/length sets match optimized suit enumeration on seven targeted group shapes.

All physical 4..10 bomb lengths, 0..2 wildcard counts, levels/nonlevel ranks passed. Rocket beats 10-bombs; classic straight flush beats five but loses to six; tournament windows follow its configured policy.

Every seat 27, exact 108-card canonical identity/fields, level/wild/joker flags and descending order passed; extreme valid RNG preserves input. Concentration is a sample statistic, not a fairness proof.

validationNotes: An initial delayed RNG fault at call 300 was never reached: the constant-0.5 clustered path uses 266 calls. The probe was corrected to calls 108,125,266; all correctly throw INVALID_DEAL_RANDOM. This was a probe-design error, not a product finding.

limitations: Subset tests verify candidate enumeration against the project's parser, not an independent external rulebook; parser interpretation/order was separately checked.
